coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Liu 2025 (stochastic noise): the convergence guarantee is a cited theorem for Gaussian noise, and shot noise is only expected to be close to it; Theorem 14's circuit form loses its product sign and Lemma 17 its square root, and the appendix results are derivations or heuristics. Liu 2025 (Yomo): Theorems 5.1 and 5.2 are quoted with their conditions and stay HIGH (fractions printed flat but with every symbol present); Theorems 5.3 and 5.4 lose their square roots, and Theorem 5.5's main-text 'smaller' is proved only as 'no larger than Vanilla's bound'. Ma 2024: Theorems 1 and 2, Corollary 1, Lemma S2 and the stated noise limit stay HIGH; the supplement's restatement of Theorem 3 appears to give a different noise bound. Makarovskiy 2026: Proposition 2 and the stated anticoncentration assumption stay HIGH; the trainability result rests on a conjectured variance decay, and Theorems 1 to 3 and Propositions 1 and 3 are cut before their formulas or lose a square root. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
